fields.statement: At bb5b5ce8 (leaf commits f82e440f and bb5b5ce8): go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(change-workflow-pin|describe-golden)$' -count=1 -v passed both scripts. change-workflow-pin.txtar pins a draft change set to docs, then change show --json shows "workflow": "docs" and run start --dry-run prints '- Workflow: docs'. It clears with --clear (previous docs, no workflow, dry run falls back to the dispatch rules), refuses nonesuch with 'no such workflow' and a landed change set with 'landed', and passes fold-ok after each step. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestChangeWorkflow passed, as did internal/changeset, entry, store and render. I read the diff: change.workflow validates the name via lookupWorkflow, refuses terminal states and live runs (refuseLiveRun), and appends a format-5 pin entry. bb5b5ce8 adds Decision pin-format-five, decided-by link. make self-check has only stale rendered actor/index files from this run's own session actors, which no leaf commit causes.
